rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something becomes physically stiff or hard.

example.english: The butter began to stiffen in the fridge.
example.traditional: 塊牛油擺咗喺雪櫃入面，開始變硬。
example.jyutping: faai3 ngau4 jau4 baai2 zo2 hai2 syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6 hoi1 ci2 bin3 ngaang6

rows.note: Use this when a person or body suddenly stiffens or freezes from shock, confusion, or fear rather than simply becoming hard.

example.english: Hearing the news made me stiffen up.
example.traditional: 聽到呢個消息，我成個人僵住咗。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 ngo5 sing4 go3 jan4 goeng1 zyu6 zo2

rows.note: Use this colloquial causative construction when someone or something makes A physically stiff or hard.

example.english: The wind and sun caused the bread to stiffen.
example.traditional: 呢幾日風吹日曬，搞到塊麵包硬晒。
example.jyutping: ne1 gei2 jat6 fung1 ceoi1 jat6 saai3 gaau2 dou3 faai3 min6 baau1 ngaang6 saai3
